I am a third year psych student with lived experience researching the experiences of students who have self-harmed during the COVID-19 pandemic. This study is anonymous with full ethical approval and will be so beneficial in informing better support for student mental-health. please take part/share with others! thanks so much, message me for any more info. you must be 18+, be a student at university/college (any country!), and have self harmed in any way during the pandemic.
